sections.heading: Seven point lights per draw, four shadow channels per scene
covered_assertions: 7 slot / 4 selector representation and four-channel authoring statement; source scope is distinct from assignment.
unextracted_assertions: Light class mappings; scene arbitration; sun channel routing; fade and cascade settings are left to adjacent audits.

sections.heading: The per-object light cap: 4, 6 or 7
covered_assertions: 7-slot shader representation and 4-shadow selectors; 4/6/7 lore, pass-builder signature, COTN mesh report, Lux split-mesh report, and random-selection anecdote are kept distinct.
unextracted_assertions: Native per-object fill/ranking and controlled flicker reproduction remain unresolved.

sections.heading: Shadow casters per scene
covered_assertions: Four selector capacity distinguished from scene allocation.
unextracted_assertions: Intellightent selection and exterior sun channel reservation remain unverified.

sections.heading: Mods attach at five distinct seams
covered_assertions: LLF filter and clustered/deferred distinction; 1024 total capacity; 128 C++ versus 256 HLSL mismatch; 64 px x 32 grid; 15 strict payload; Light Placer creates engine objects; postprocess ownership conditions.
unextracted_assertions: Exact Lux/ELFX/Relighting assets, Intellightent source, ENB emitter behavior, ReShade implementation, and current install activation.

sections.heading: Address Library IDs worth knowing (SE, AE)
covered_assertions: Address Library IDs are source/version labels only; no target hook execution is inferred.
unextracted_assertions: Individual IDs were not checked against selected runtime binary in this mod audit.

sections.heading: Conclusion
covered_assertions: ENB postprocess option is configurable; 1.6 is a CS fit; CS+Light Placer recommendation is not evidence for vanilla-target fidelity.
unextracted_assertions: Other lighting/color formulas and LE scope belong to adjacent audits; ecosystem recommendation does not establish target implementation.

sections.heading: Community Shaders deferred conversion paragraph
covered_assertions: CS deferred hooks/composite are separate from clustered direct-light shading.
unextracted_assertions: Full frame order is not audited here.
